name: What is the typical lifespan of a scale control system?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of a scale control system?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical lifespan of a scale control system can vary significantly based on the type of technology, manufacturer quality, and how well it is maintained. Many quality systems are designed to last 5 to 10 years or even longer with proper care. Factors such as consistent water hardness levels, proper installation, and adherence to recommended maintenance schedules (like filter replacements) can directly impact its longevity. Investing in a reputable brand and professional installation from companies like CG Plumbing Solutions can contribute to a longer service life and better performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: The lifespan of a scale control system is typically 5-10+ years, depending on system type, quality, installation, and consistent maintenance.
